answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because juniper only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. In practice zephyr is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any walnut approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
